plugins.title: Mono Synth
plugins.subtitle: Play notes on the keyboard. Shape each one with attack, decay, sustain, release and volume.

plugins.title: Synth With Presets
plugins.subtitle: A small synth with three factory presets — Pluck, Pad and Sine. Pick one and the knobs move.

plugins.title: Gain & Pan
plugins.subtitle: Make the sound louder or quieter and move it left or right. A looping backing track runs through it — watch the meter.

plugins.title: State Memo
plugins.subtitle: A volume control plus a text note that saves and reloads with the plugin.

plugins.title: MIDI Transpose
plugins.subtitle: Shifts every note you play up or down by a set number of semitones and octaves.

plugins.title: MPE Spreader
plugins.subtitle: Gives each note you hold its own channel, so a chord spreads out across the lanes.

plugins.title: MIDI Inspector
plugins.subtitle: Shows every MIDI message going through, live — name, channel and raw bytes.

plugins.title: SysEx Echo
plugins.subtitle: Send it a SysEx message and it sends the same bytes right back.
